description_en: A peacock chair with a fan-shaped tall woven back, circular seat and coiled arms; the front shows the radiating back silhouette, the side reveals the thin fan and cylindrical seat base, and the rear shows radial ribs, bindings and the seat-to-fan brace. Show this single complete furniture object alone on a plain studio background. All surfaces, hardware and panels must be unmarked, with no letters, numbers, logos, labels, captions or watermarks.
